messages:
Ana Gomez: quick note on BoutiqueCart onboarding 1: p95 for chat endpoints ~120ms above baseline last week, token burn +20%. AM flagged as at-risk for renewal if we cant show immediate ops plan. proposing a three-part proactive play: AWQ pilot on non-sensitive intents, compact-model swap for recap flows, and intent-based routing toDedicated during peak. thoughts?
Will Park: sounds good. prioritize intents that are low-safety (order-summary, faq, receipts). avoid payments/authorization. recommend 24h micro-canary first to catch obvious regressions. capture embedding stability for rerank flows.
Samir Rao: agree but add warmup and KV cache steps. when swapping model families we often see initial p95 blips from cold KV. suggest pre-warm + short synthetic ramp for 15 minutes and enable prefix caching for top 40 prefixes.
Ana Gomez: plan sketch: 1) micro-canary AWQ on 5% traffic for 24h across receipt/faq intents, 2) if similarity delta < 0.02 expand to 30% and enable compact-model for summary path with routing weight ramp, 3) dedicated routing for peak hours with pre-warm. rollback if any metric breaches.
Will Park: sample canary snippet you can reuse:
```yaml
canary:
  name: boutiquecart-awq-micro
  models: [horizon-1.4-awq, horizon-1.4-awq-fast]
  initial_traffic: 0.05
  eval_prompts: ["order_summary_short","faq_get_shipping","receipt_extract"]
  metrics: [p95_latency, answer_cosine, token_cost_pct, user_error_rate]
  rollback_conditions:
    - answer_cosine_drop>0.02
    - user_error_rate_increase>0.004
    - p95_increase>0.12
```
Samir Rao: I'll own warmup hooks on the dedicated pool + KV-prefetch for top prefixes. I'll also wire an ops alert to page if p95 > baseline + 25ms during rollout.
Ana Gomez: I'll draft customer-facing note with conservative savings estimate (7-11%) and show rollback plan + 14-day checkpoint. want to emphasize we won't change high-sensitivity flows.
Will Park: add small human eval: 30 queries across intents for perceived quality. I'll recruit a couple of AMs to label.
cs-automation-bot: reminder set: BoutiqueCart_canary_check at 2798840000. create incident if rollback conditions met.
Samir Rao: assigning: @Will human eval & eval rubric, @Samir warmup + alerting (owning infra), @Ana customer note + renewal slide.
Ana Gomez: will update CS healthboard after we start canary. leaving note for AM: propose renewal cushion if we hit expected savings at 30-day checkpoint. :thumbsup:
Will Park: ack.
Samir Rao: on it.
